Convert Opta (period, clock) times to one continuous match clock

Source: R/splint_creation.R
dot-continuous_minute.Rd

Opta's clock runs ON through first-half stoppage (period 1 can reach minute 56) and the second half RESTARTS at 45, so first-half stoppage and the start of the second half share clock values (review R009). This shifts period-2 times by the real first-half length and extra-time periods by the real end of the second half, so every splint time (boundaries, shots, player on/off, value streams) sits on one timeline.

Usage

.continuous_minute(
  t,
  period_id,
  first_half_end,
  second_half_end_raw = NA_real_
)

Arguments

t

Numeric clock minutes (minute + second/60).

period_id

Integer period (1, 2; 3/4 extra time).

first_half_end

First-half end on the raw clock (period-1 type 30 marker), recycled. NA leaves period-2+ times unshifted.

second_half_end_raw

Second-half end on the raw clock (period-2 marker). NA shifts extra time like period 2.

Value

Numeric continuous minutes.
